title: When a desk computer cannot send cash or a new member, only that computer knows
what: If the gym server refuses a payment, a new member or a check-in that a desk saved without internet, or the desk cannot keep it at all, the reason goes only into the browser's hidden log on that one computer. The automatic crash reports catch only errors nobody handled, so these never reach MettleUp. An owner on another phone does not see the held cash either.
expected: Each refused, stuck or not-kept desk save (no member details) is reported to MettleUp, and the owner sees a count of held items on any device.
how_often: every refused or stuck offline save
fix_line: Send a short note with no personal data to MettleUp for each held or lost desk save, and show held items to the owner on every device

title: Sign-in and staff screens say "Something went wrong" and keep no note of why
what: Signing in, Forgot your PIN, adding or removing a person, making a code and Put your records online show "Something went wrong. Please try again." for any failure they do not know. None of these keeps any note of the real reason, not even in the browser's own log, so neither the gym nor MettleUp support can find out what broke. Retiring the old owner key after going online also fails without a trace.
expected: Every "try again" message also records the real reason, and unknown failures reach MettleUp.
how_often: every unknown sign-in or staff-list failure
fix_line: Log the reason in each of these places and send unknown ones with the crash reports

title: When MettleUp's gym server is down, the gym is told its own internet is broken
what: If the gym server does not answer, the panel cannot tell that apart from the gym's wifi dropping. The desk bar says "No internet" and sign-in says "Can't reach the internet. Check the connection". If the server answers with an error instead, the screen just says "Something went wrong". Staff will restart routers and call their internet company while the fault is ours.
expected: When the internet works but MettleUp does not answer, the screen says MettleUp is having a problem and that the desk can keep working offline.
fix_line: Tell a server outage apart from no internet and use outage words

items.reason: Only the background sync applies to a web page: it reruns every 15 seconds and on focus, page shown and internet back. Heart rate, rest timer, workout clock and watch states do not exist in a web page.
